d:
Jharkhand | nahay-khay men kaddu-bhat khane ki paranpra kyon? ranchi ke bajar men janie kaddu ka bhav | Chhath
Jharkhand samet pure desh men lok aastha ke mahaparv chhath ki taiyariyan shuru ho gaee hain. ranchi ke bajar chhath puja ki kharidari ke lie saj chuke hain. kal yani nahay-khay ke sath char divsiy chhath mahaparv ki shuruaat hogi.
